name: The Schlossberg Field Maple
verified_sources: https://geodaten.graz.at/arcgis/rest/services/OGD/OGD_WFS/MapServer/8/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson (Stadt Graz Naturdenkmale, register_id 118, object_id 112, Feldahorn/Acer campestre, owner oeffentlich)
https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liste_der_Naturdenkm%C3%A4ler_in_Graz (Steirisches Naturdenkmal 1270, 'Ahorn', Standort Schlossberg, KG Innere Stadt, protected 24.05.2000)
access: Free. Stands in the public Schlossberg hill park in the historic centre, open at all times; reachable on foot via paths and stairs, or by the paid Schlossbergbahn funicular.
transport: Tram 3 or 5 to the Schlossbergbahn stop, then a short walk up the hill (funicular also available, paid).
verify_notes: Two independently maintained sources agree on the exact spot: the city's own live Naturdenkmale GIS layer (fetched 2026-08-16, licence CC BY 4.0) and Wikipedia's 'Liste der Naturdenkmäler in Graz' (Steirisches ND 1270, geocoded independently, lands within 3 metres of the register point). The register gives the species as Acer campestre (Field Maple); Wikipedia's entry only says 'Ahorn' (maple, genus level) without an epithet, so the species-level identification currently rests on the register alone, not on a second independent species confirmation. Protection date given as 24.05.2000. No age, girth or height figure found in either source; the Schlossberg's mixed deciduous woodland (beech, hornbeam, ash, several maple species) is centuries-managed but that is a fact about the hill, not this specific tree, so no age is stated. Worth a reader photo with a tape measure round the trunk. The hill itself is Graz's best-known public landmark, a wooded park around the medieval fortress remains and clock tower, freely open.

name: The Volksgarten Oak
verified_sources: https://geodaten.graz.at/arcgis/rest/services/OGD/OGD_WFS/MapServer/8/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson (Stadt Graz Naturdenkmale, register_id 117, object_id 98, Stieleiche/Quercus robur, owner oeffentlich)
https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liste_der_Naturdenkm%C3%A4ler_in_Graz (Steirisches Naturdenkmal 1269, 'Eiche (Quercus robur)', Standort Mühlgasse 43, KG Lend, protected 25.05.2000)

https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Volksgarten_(Graz) (confirms the Volksgarten is a free, 4.6 ha public park accessible from all four sides, containing several Naturdenkmal trees including a north-south row of oaks)
access: Free. Public park (Volksgarten, 4.6 ha), open on all sides, no entry fee, no restricted hours mentioned by any source.
transport: Short walk from Graz Hauptbahnhof (about 1km) or tram/bus to Elisabethinergasse / Keplerbrücke area, then into the park via any of its entrances.
verify_notes: Register and Wikipedia geocode within 2 metres of each other, both giving Mühlgasse 43 as the address; the Volksgarten's own Wikipedia article independently confirms the park (whose entrances also include Volksgartenstraße and Mühlgasse) holds several individually designated Naturdenkmal trees. That article separately describes a roughly 80-100 year old north-south row of oaks through the park centre, but does not say this specific designated oak is part of that row, so that age is NOT applied here (avoiding the bridge-claim trap: a fact about the park's oak row is not automatically a fact about this individual protected tree). No girth or planting date found for this specific tree. Species agrees across both sources (Quercus robur). Two other Naturdenkmal trees stand in the same small park (see grz_003 and grz_004), making this a genuine walkable three-tree cluster inside one park.

name: The Volksgarten Plane (Mühlgasse)
species: London Plane (Platanus x hispanica, recorded elsewhere as Platanus x acerifolia)
verified_sources: https://geodaten.graz.at/arcgis/rest/services/OGD/OGD_WFS/MapServer/8/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson (Stadt Graz Naturdenkmale, register_id 119, object_id 1, Platane/Platanus x hispanica, owner oeffentlich)
https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liste_der_Naturdenkm%C3%A4ler_in_Graz (Steirisches Naturdenkmal 1290, 'Platane (Platanus x acerifolia)', Standort Mühlgasse 43, KG Lend, protected 05.07.2000)
Wikimedia Commons file 'Platane Volksgarten Graz 1290 (2).JPG' independently confirms this tree stands in the Volksgarten, matching ND 1290
access: Free. Public park (Volksgarten), open on all sides, no entry fee.
transport: Short walk from Graz Hauptbahnhof (about 1km) or tram/bus to Elisabethinergasse / Keplerbrücke area, then into the park.
verify_notes: Register and Wikipedia geocode within 3 metres of each other. Species differs slightly in the Latin binomial used (register: Platanus x hispanica; Wikipedia: Platanus x acerifolia), which are two names commonly used for the same London Plane hybrid; recording both here rather than silently picking one. A Wikimedia Commons file titled 'Platane Volksgarten Graz 1290' independently corroborates that ND 1290 stands specifically in the Volksgarten (not merely nearby), which is useful since the street address (Mühlgasse) could otherwise read as outside the park. No age or girth found. Stands close to grz_002 and grz_004 in the same small park, part of the three-tree Volksgarten cluster.

name: The Augarten Field Maple
age_estimate: at least 70 years (documented as an already-noted specimen in 1956)

location.neighbourhood: Jakomini, at the eastern edge of the Augarten park

verified_sources: https://geodaten.graz.at/arcgis/rest/services/OGD/OGD_WFS/MapServer/8/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson (Stadt Graz Naturdenkmale, register_id 38, object_id 75, Feldahorn/Acer campestre, owner oeffentlich)

https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liste_der_Naturdenkm%C3%A4ler_in_Graz (Steirisches Naturdenkmal 1009, 'Feldahorn', Standort Friedrichgasse 41, KG Jakomini, protected 05.07.1979; cites F. Hanselmayer, 'In Graz gepflanzte Laubhölzer' (1956), as already listing this tree under protection)

https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Museum_der_Wahrnehmung (confirms Friedrichgasse 41 is a free-standing former public bath building at the eastern edge of the Grazer Augarten, a public park, with no dedicated private garden described)
access: Free to view; the address is a heritage building (now the Museum der Wahrnehmung) standing at the edge of the public Augarten park. Not confirmed on the ground whether the tree itself is inside the museum's own footprint or on the adjoining public park land, so flagged rather than stated as certain.
transport: Walkable from Graz Hauptbahnhof or the city centre (Augarten sits between the Mur river and Jakomini); tram/bus toward Elisabethstraße/Jakominiplatz, then a short walk to the Augarten.
verify_notes: Register and Wikipedia geocode within 4 metres of each other on the exact tree. Genuinely useful anecdote: Wikipedia's list cites F. Hanselmayer's 1956 survey 'In Graz gepflanzte Laubhölzer' as already recording this Feldahorn under nature protection at that date, decades before its formal 1979 designation date in this list, so the tree demonstrably existed and was already notable by 1956 (at least 70 years old as of 2026). That is the only basis for the age_min given; no growth-rate or girth-based estimate was attempted since no girth was found, and age_max is left empty because nothing bounds it above. FLAGGED for a genuine but narrow uncertainty, not about the tree's existence: the postal address belongs to a heritage bathhouse building (now Museum der Wahrnehmung) that Wikipedia describes as standing 'freely at the edge of the Augarten', with no private garden mentioned, which suggests the tree is on or immediately beside the public park rather than gated museum ground, but this was not confirmed with a source that states it explicitly. Worth a one-line access check by a future pass or reader before publishing with full confidence.

name: The Panoramagasse Oak (54)
verified_sources: https://geodaten.graz.at/arcgis/rest/services/OGD/OGD_WFS/MapServer/8/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson (Stadt Graz Naturdenkmale, register_id 15, object_id 64, Stieleiche/Quercus robur, owner oeffentlich)

https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liste_der_Naturdenkm%C3%A4ler_in_Graz (Steirisches Naturdenkmal 989, 'Sommereiche', Standort Panoramagasse 54 gegenüber, KG Geidorf, protected 11.07.1979; records a trunk circumference of 2.80 m measured in 2015 at breast height)
access: Free. Register lists the owner as 'oeffentlich' and the tree stands on public ground opposite the house number given (a street-side position), on the Ruckerlberg hillside in Geidorf.
transport: Bus toward Ruckerlberggürtel / Geidorf, then a walk up Panoramagasse (a hillside street with views over the city).
verify_notes: Register and Wikipedia geocode within 2 metres. Wikipedia records a real, dated field measurement: trunk circumference 2.80 m, measured at breast height in 2015, which is recorded here as girth_cm per the standing instruction to always capture girth when a source gives it. No age is derived from this girth because no specific published growth-rate figure for Quercus robur was verified during this pass; deriving a number from girth without that citation would be guessing dressed as a calculation, which the rules forbid. Leaving age_estimate empty for a future pass or reader question rather than inventing one. 'Gegenüber' (opposite) in the register means the tree stands across the street from house number 54, i.e. on the public verge/hillside, not in a private garden.

name: The Panoramagasse Oak (56)
verified_sources: https://geodaten.graz.at/arcgis/rest/services/OGD/OGD_WFS/MapServer/8/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson (Stadt Graz Naturdenkmale, register_id 16, object_id 65, Stieleiche/Quercus robur, owner oeffentlich)

https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liste_der_Naturdenkm%C3%A4ler_in_Graz (Steirisches Naturdenkmal 990, 'Sommereiche', Standort Panoramagasse 56 gegenüber, KG Geidorf, protected 11.07.1979; records a trunk circumference of 4.90 m measured in 2015 at breast height)
access: Free. Register lists the owner as 'oeffentlich'; stands on public ground opposite the house number given, about 40m from grz_007 along the same street.
transport: Bus toward Ruckerlberggürtel / Geidorf, then a walk up Panoramagasse; walkable from grz_007 in about a minute.
verify_notes: Register and Wikipedia geocode within 3 metres. Field-measured trunk circumference of 4.90 m in 2015 (recorded as girth_cm), substantially thicker than its neighbour at Panoramagasse 54 (2.80 m) despite the same protection date (11.07.1979) and near-identical address, which is worth a line in the story: two oaks protected on the same day, one nearly twice the other's girth. No age derived, same reasoning as grz_007: no verified published growth-rate citation for Quercus robur was in hand this pass, so age_estimate stays empty rather than guessed. Not a register 'twin' in the corrupted-duplicate sense: two visibly different, separately measured trees roughly 40m apart on the same street.
